v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce véniet * Dóminus princeps regum terræ: beáti, qui parati sunt occúrrere illi.
text.en: Behold, the Lord cometh, * the Prince of the Kings of the earth: blessed are they that are ready to go forth to meet him.

text.la: Cum vénerit * Fílius hóminis, putas invéniet fidem super terram?
text.en: When the Son of man cometh, * shall he find faith on the earth?

text.la: Ecce iam venit * plenitúdo témporis, in quo misit Deus Fílium suum in terras.
text.en: Behold, the fulness * of the time is come, when God sent forth his Son into the world.

text.la: Hauriétis aquas * in gáudio de fóntibus Salvatóris.
text.en: With joy * shall ye draw water out of the wells of the Saviour.

text.la: Egrediétur * Dóminus de loco sancto suo: véniet ut salvet pópulum suum.
text.en: The Lord goeth forth * from his holy place he cometh to save his people.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Dicit Dóminus: * Pœniténtiam ágite: appropinquávit enim regnum cælórum, allelúia.
text.en: Thus saith the Lord: * Repent ye, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand. Alleluia.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: et magna nobis virtúte succúrre; ut per auxílium grátiæ tuæ, quod nostra peccáta præpédiunt, indulgéntia tuæ propitiatiónis accéleret:
text.en: Stir up, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy power, and come; make haste to our aid with thy great might; that, by the help of thy grace, that which is hindered by our sins may be hastened by thy merciful forgiveness.

office.title: Feria II infra Hebd IV Adventus
